object_context: For smooth projective complex X, p>=0, and alpha in H^{2p}(X,Q) of type (p,p), find a nonconjectural source-object/correspondence criterion forcing alpha into im(cl_Q:CH^p(X)_Q->H^{2p}(X,Q)); do not assume Hodge, standard, Tate, period, or equivalent algebraicity conjectures.
structural_coordinates: root coefficients are rational; integral strengthening is not admissible
algebraic cycles are source witnesses; Hodge/absolute/motivated/categorical labels are target-side realization structure
the unresolved direction is image/lifting through a realization map
motivated correspondences enlarge Chow correspondences by formally allowed Lefschetz inverses
categorical routes require an actual object/kernel, not only a class in a realization lattice
arithmetic reduction needs both special-fiber algebraicity and a lift back to characteristic zero
equivalent_formulations: surjectivity, up to motive conventions, of algebraic-cycle/Tate-motive Hom under Betti-Hodge realization onto Q(0)->H^{2p}(X,Q)(p)
construct Z in CH^p(X)_Q with cl(Z)=alpha
solved_analogues: Lefschetz (1,1): codimension-one rational Hodge classes are divisor classes
near_solved_analogues: Deligne: Hodge cycles on abelian varieties are absolute Hodge, but this does not generally supply algebraic representatives
André: motivated motives/deformation have strong unconditional formal properties in an enlarged correspondence category
Arapura: actual algebraic correspondences can transfer Hodge/standard-conjecture results in motivated examples
Perry: object/moduli methods prove a categorical integral Hodge result for special 2-Calabi-Yau categories

method_transfers.method: produce an actual geometric object whose characteristic/cycle class equals the Hodge class
shared_structure: both are preimage problems for a geometric realization map
required_assumptions: codimension one in the source theorem
disanalogies: no general higher-codimension Picard-style surjectivity theorem is known
method_transfers.repair_question: What higher-codimension source object/correspondence can be proved to realize arbitrary alpha?

method_transfers.method: organize classes using motivated correspondences and formally adjoined Lefschetz inverses
shared_structure: correspondence categories map to Hodge realizations
required_assumptions: motivated status is kept distinct from Chow algebraicity
disanalogies: motivated correspondences need not be known algebraic; André's algebraic deformation bridge is tied to standard conjectures
method_transfers.repair_question: Can every motivated operation used for alpha be algebraized without a standard-conjecture input?

method_transfers.method: use an actual algebraic correspondence, Fourier-Mukai kernel, or moduli object to transfer/realize a source class
shared_structure: object-level witnesses can map to target cohomology classes
required_assumptions: the relevant source Hodge classes are already algebraic
disanalogies: arbitrary X,alpha need not lie in the image of any known source correspondence or object-realization map
method_transfers.repair_question: Which verifiable representability/span condition forces alpha into an explicit algebraic-correspondence image?

explicit_disanalogies: Atiyah-Hirzebruch integral counterexamples forbid replacing the rational root by integral Hodge
Cattani-Deligne-Kaplan algebraicity of a Hodge locus is parameter-space algebraicity, not a cycle on each fiber
absolute Hodge and motivated are not synonyms for algebraic
Tate/period constraints do not give a characteristic-zero Chow witness without separate bridges

Deligne et al., Hodge Cycles, Motives, and Shimura Varieties, LNM 900 (1982)

common_abstraction: source objects map to a coarser target representation
target admissibility need not characterize the image
shared_constraints: a valid lift must re-realize to the target
disanalogies: Hodge realization has tensor/algebraic structure absent from ordinary compilers

cross_domain_analogies.validation_obligation: Specify source category, target category, exact realization map, source witness, and theorem-backed proof that its image equals alpha without hidden conjectures.
